ValidationRule.description: Min Term Months must be at least 1 and no more than Max Term Months (at most 120).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Min_Term_Months__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Max_Term_Months__c)), OR(Min_Term_Months__c < 1, Max_Term_Months__c > 120, Min_Term_Months__c > Max_Term_Months__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Min Term Months must be at least 1 and no more than Max Term Months (at most 120).
